meta.titleEn: L-Cystine 500 mg Soft Capsules (Skin and Hair Adjuvant Medicine)
meta.actionKo: 각질 형성에 필요한 아미노산을 보충하여 습진·여드름과 손발톱·머리카락 갈라짐 등 각질부위 질환의 보조치료에 쓰는 약입니다.
meta.actionEn: A medicine that supplies an amino acid needed for keratin formation, used as adjuvant treatment for eczema, acne, and keratin-area conditions such as splitting nails and hair.

60fda01a.symKo: 습진·여드름의 보조치료, 손톱·발톱·머리카락이 쉽게 갈라지는 각질부위 질환의 보조치료
60fda01a.symEn: Adjuvant treatment of eczema and acne, and of keratin-area conditions such as easily splitting fingernails, toenails, and hair
60fda01a.pointKo: 습진·여드름과 손발톱·모발 갈라짐에 쓰는 L-시스틴 보조치료제입니다.
60fda01a.pointEn: An L-cystine adjuvant medicine for eczema, acne, and splitting nails and hair.

en.60fda01a: This medicine is used as adjuvant treatment for eczema and acne, and as adjuvant treatment for conditions of keratin areas such as fingernails, toenails, or hair that split easily.
en.1fad28f0: Take 2 to 4 capsules (1,000 to 2,000 mg) per 1 day, for 10 to 20 days out of 1 month.
en.e89af9c5: Take 1,000 to 2,000 mg of this medicine per 1 day, for 10 to 20 days out of 1 month.
en.037720f9: Do not take this medicine if you have severe kidney dysfunction or hepatic coma, are a child 6 years old or younger, have cystinuria, are hypersensitive to soybean oil or have experienced allergic reactions to it, or are hypersensitive to soybeans or peanuts.
en.80f7d2a2: Do not take this medicine if you have severe kidney dysfunction or hepatic coma, are a child 6 years old or younger, have cystinuria, are hypersensitive to soybean oil or have experienced allergies to it, or are hypersensitive to soybeans or peanuts.
en.c0085c69: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are hypersensitive to it or have kidney stones (nephrolithiasis).
en.f88bad97: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are hypersensitive to it; have kidney stones (nephrolithiasis); have fat metabolism disorders such as hyperlipoproteinemia, diabetic hyperlipidemia, or pancreatitis, or must use lipid emulsions with caution; or are hypersensitive to Yellow No. 5 (Sunset Yellow FCF) or have experienced allergies to it.
en.26152e9f: If sometimes nausea, or rarely diarrhea, dry mouth, or mild abdominal pain occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
en.4d7c6f40: Sometimes nausea, and rarely diarrhea, dry mouth (thirst), and mild abdominal (stomach) pain may occur; in this case, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
en.0f06fc5c: If symptoms do not improve after taking this medicine for about 1 month, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
